स्वकर्मसु प्रवर्तन्ते तुष्ठाः स्वैरेव कर्मभिः
English_translation:

 merchants agriculturists Shudras servant class performing duties 
 satisfied work bereft greed Rama ruling people 
 intent virtue lived telling lies
